OVERVIEW
Education Is Changing / The Ecosystem Must Change With It
"Education is no longer evolving in isolation." — EduBeacon Core Philosophy
Technology, changing learner expectations, new skills and evolving school needs are reshaping education at every level.

EduBeacon brings the people shaping this transformation into one connected ecosystem. From school leaders and educators to startups, technology providers, institutions and industry partners, EduBeacon creates opportunities to discover new possibilities, exchange knowledge and build meaningful partnerships.
"Because the future of education is not built by one stakeholder. It is built together."

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Everything You Need to Know

What is EduBeacon? — EduBeacon is a global education innovation ecosystem that brings together school owners, principals, educators, EdTech founders, solution providers, and policy makers to discover, collaborate, and grow.
Who can attend? — The conference is curated for K-12 school leaders, principals, educators, EdTech startups, corporate partners, higher-ed institutions, investors, and policymakers.

Why should schools participate? — Schools gain access to 300+ verified solution providers, explore cutting-edge technologies (AI, Robotics, STEM, ERPs), attend keynote masterclasses, and receive certified professional development.

Why should EdTech startups participate? — Startups can demonstrate their solutions directly to over 500+ verified school decision-makers, secure pre-arranged 1:1 curated meetings, and explore institutional partnerships.
Can companies become partners or sponsors? — Yes. We offer Title, Diamond, Gold, and Silver sponsorship packages, exhibition booth spaces, and bespoke branding packages.
Can I apply to become a speaker? — Yes. Educators, researchers, and innovative founders can submit session abstracts and speaker applications through our inquiry form.
Are workshops and masterclasses included in the pass? — Yes. All delegate passes include full access to hands-on workshops, plenary tracks, and masterclasses across both days.
How can I register? — Simply click 'Register Now' or choose your delegate tier on this page. School leaders can apply for complimentary passes subject to verification.
How can my organisation become a sponsor? — Review our sponsorship tiers on this page and submit an inquiry or download the official sponsorship prospectus.
Where and when will the event take place? — The Annual Summit takes place on 15–16 November 2027 at Hotel Aketa, Rajpur Road, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India.
What opportunities are available for early-stage startups? — Startups can join the EdTech Launchpad, participate in investor pitching rounds, and exhibit in the dedicated Innovation Showcase dome.

Can schools explore and test technology solutions live at the event? — Yes. The Exhibition Floor features interactive smart classroom setups, robotics arenas, and AI demo pods where teachers and leaders can test solutions hands-on.
